trigger_source.description: Where each frame comes from. 'line0' / 'line1': the camera's hardware input on that line (a Basler's opto-isolated input is Line1, a FLIR Blackfly's Line0), wired to a timing-system output gated by the trigger box; the line must be one of the camera's own TriggerSource choices. 'software': the scan worker presses the camera's software trigger at each shot (exposed when the worker says go, not when the laser fires).

EpicsMotor.description:
A positioner: one device, one EPICS motor record per axis.

The axes are the record names under the device's prefix
(``<experiment>:<device>:<axis>``), so the entry still carries names
only; tolerance, units and limits live in the record (``.RDBD``,
``.EGU``, ``.HLM``/``.LLM``), the one home for device facts.  Each axis
binds as a scan axis ``Device:axis`` (the same spelling as a DB
device's settable), and the device as a whole is a per-row scalar
device (every axis's readback).

kind.description: Device kind: 'epics_motor' (EPICS motor records, one per axis).
kind.title: Kind

SetpointDevice.description:
A setpoint device: a supply's plain records (``NATIVE_DEVICES.md`` §8).

The entry names the records under the device's prefix
(``<experiment>:<device>:<record>``), since the worker has no DB rows to
enumerate them: each settable is its readback record, written at its
setpoint record (``<record>:SP``, or the family's setpoint role for that
readback) and confirmed on the readback within its tolerance; readbacks
are extra row columns; status bits are two-state records that fail a
set when they read 1. Limits and units live in the records
(``DRVH``/``DRVL``, ``EGU``), the one home for device facts.

kind.description: Device kind: 'setpoint_device' (a supply's plain records: setpoint, readback, status bits).
kind.title: Kind

template.description: The family file the device instantiates, one of its kind's; absent: the kind's default (REGISTRY_KIND_FAMILIES). A device also in panel_devices.yaml names the same family there. Older readers refuse the key: write it only once every reader has this schema.
template.title: Template

settables.description: The settables, by readback record name under the device's prefix (e.g. {'current': {tolerance: 0.005}} for '<experiment>:<device>:current', written at 'current:SP'). Each is a scan axis 'Device:record' and an action's set target.
settables.title: Settables

readbacks.description: Further numeric readback records, read into each row beside the settables' own (e.g. ['voltage']).
readbacks.title: Readbacks

status.description: Status bits, two-state records that read 1 when tripped (e.g. ['fault', 'interlock']): a set is refused while one reads 1 and fails if one rises while it waits.
status.title: Status

SetpointSettable.description: One settable of a setpoint device: how close its readback must come, and how soon.

tolerance.description: How close the readback must come to the requested value for the set to be done, in the record's units (e.g. 0.005 for 5 mA on a supply in A). The one device fact a plain 'ao' record cannot hold.
tolerance.title: Tolerance

timeout.description: Seconds the set waits for the readback to arrive within the tolerance after the write, before it fails. Size it for the slowest ramp plus the readback's scan period.
timeout.title: Timeout
